name: Multi-split AC units
description: One outdoor unit runs two to five indoor units, ideal for apartments and villas short on balcony or terrace space.
long_description: A multi-split connects a single inverter outdoor unit to several indoor units, each with its own remote and temperature setting. It frees up balcony and façade space compared with fitting a separate outdoor unit for every room, and the inverter compressor adjusts to how many rooms are actually running.
features: Each room has its own on/off and temperature control
Saves balcony, terrace and façade space
Mix wall, cassette and concealed indoor units

specs.label: Piping
specs.value: Separate copper line set to each indoor unit

variants.suits: Two bedrooms or a bedroom + living room

considerations: If the outdoor unit fails, all connected rooms lose cooling
Piping lengths to each room must stay within the maker's limits
For more than about five rooms, a VRF system is usually a better fit

faqs.question: Is multi-split cheaper than separate splits?
faqs.answer: The equipment usually costs a little more, but you save outdoor space and often get better efficiency when only some rooms are in use.

faqs.question: Can I add rooms later?
faqs.answer: Only up to the number of ports the outdoor unit has, so plan for the final number of rooms at the start.
